assumptions: The orchestrator calls scenario.score() before condition.teardown(), so a snapshot taken just before scoring still sees a live store
A fresh benchmark working directory has no legacy .twining content, so resolveAutoBackend returns sqlite for every future run
Benchmark agents do not create git commits themselves, so commit_hashes stays empty
constraints: Must not modify any existing scorer in src/scenarios/ — two were just corrected and a simultaneous change would make deltas unattributable
Must not run benchmarks — runs cost real money and are the owner's call
Twining stores must be read strictly read-only
TypeScript strict; npx tsc --noEmit and npx vitest run must both pass
context: Built a record-content analyzer for the benchmark harness: scores .twining/ store record QUALITY (rationale authored vs derived, alternatives with real reasons, scope, affected files) instead of tool-call names
rationale: a store of summary projections can legitimately read 100 on the two terms that survived while saying nothing about rationale, and a bare 100 invites exactly the misreading the dimension exists to prevent.
summary: Chose to add an explicit measuredWeight field to the score result —
